reason: I'm two waiters down and barely holding the floor together. I'm not putting a new payment flow on the tables right now, even if it's free for three months, because my remaining staff would see it as a threat to their tips and I can't afford to lose another one.
objection: If guests pay on their phone and walk out, what happens to the waiter's tip? My staff will fight it, and on top of the 59 GEL there's a transaction fee next to the one I already pay on my terminal.
would_change_my_mind: A clear tip button that goes straight to the waiter, plus seeing another Tbilisi restaurant my size run it for a couple of months without staff complaints. I'd look again once I'm fully staffed.
